slides.narration: Chapter 6: The Triangle. At stage six of the tower, three positions — three, five, and seven — form a closed loop. This triangle is the birthplace of both space and the strong force.

In the eight-position tower at stage six, positions three, five, and seven are special. They connect the sub-registers of the tower, acting as bridges. And these three bridges form a triangle — the first closed structure.

These three bridges do double duty. They give us three spatial dimensions — the three directions of space we move through every day. And they give us SU(3), the symmetry group of the strong force that holds protons and neutrons together. Space and color share the same origin.
